references.text: Parallel law text about the Hebrew slave who chooses to stay with his master because he loves him, his household, and is well off with him.
Messianic psalm where the servant expresses his love and willingness to do the Lord's will, an image of voluntary service.
The Lord's servant who willingly submits and does not rebel against his Master.
Christ who took on the form of a servant and voluntarily became obedient unto death, a perfect picture of the faithful servant who chooses to remain with his Master out of love.
Quotes Psalm 40 and applies it to Christ who voluntarily gives himself in service to God.
Direct parallel describing the same event and legislation from two different perspectives.
